title: System shall analyze source repositories across SCM providers
description: The system shall analyze repositories from ADO, Bitbucket Server, Bitbucket Cloud, GitHub, and GitLab to produce one issue per source repo.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall support dry-run migrations to a sandbox destination
description: The system shall execute non-production GEI migrations into a sandbox org configured via vars.SANDBOX_ORG.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall support production migrations to the destination
description: The system shall execute production GEI migrations to the target dst-org for each issue.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall support re-migration of previously migrated repositories
description: The system shall delete and re-create destination repos via /remigrate to allow re-running a prior migration.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall archive source repos after migration
description: The system shall archive (or set read-only / disable) the source repository at the source SCM via /archive.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall attach destination GitHub teams to migrated repositories
description: The system shall create and attach <base>-read/-write/-admin teams from the dst-team: label to migrated repos.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall apply post-migration fixes
description: The system shall push an amp/migration-fixes branch to the destination rewriting submodule, workflow, and CODEOWNERS references.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall validate destination integrity after migration
description: The system shall compare destination branch/tag/commit counts to the analyze-time numbers and label status:validate-passed or status:validate-failed.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall carry custom repository properties to the destination
description: The system shall apply analyze-time custom repository properties to the destination, creating schemas at the org level if missing.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall provide AI-assisted failure analysis
description: The system shall run a three-tier advisor (rules, LLM tool-use, heuristic) on any failure and optionally apply repairs to a -fixed companion repo.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall queue migrations to respect concurrency caps
description: The system shall serialize concurrent migrations behind a capacity-aware dispatcher to stay under GitHub's per-org cap.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall support bulk routing-label assignment
description: The system shall accept CSV (amp bulk-assign) and Excel (amp import-commands) inputs to apply routing labels at scale.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall expose state through a Projects v2 Kanban
description: The system shall sync each issue's status:* label to a GitHub Projects v2 single-select field, with drag-to-trigger semantics for selected columns.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall produce daily activity reports and exports
description: The system shall generate daily reports, dashboards, CSV exports, and XLSX exports summarizing migration progress.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: System shall operate via both CLI and IssueOps entry points
description: The system shall expose every operation through the amp CLI and through GitHub Actions workflows triggered by labels and comments.
acceptance_criteria: See child requirements
notes: Level-1 capability statement

title: BaseAnalyzer orchestrator
description: The analyzer shall run per-provider subclasses of BaseAnalyzer producing a RepoAnalysis dataclass per source repo.
acceptance_criteria: BaseAnalyzer class is abstract with analyze_repo defined | One RepoAnalysis emitted per source repo | Each provider analyzer subclasses BaseAnalyzer
notes: Abstract base; concrete subclasses required per provider

title: Concurrent analysis via ThreadPoolExecutor
description: The analyzer shall fan analysis out over a ThreadPoolExecutor with a configurable max_workers (default 4).
acceptance_criteria: max_workers defaults to 4 | ThreadPoolExecutor used in _analyze_one_namespace | Per-repo failures do not abort the batch
notes: Tunable for self-hosted runners with more cores

title: GitHub source analyzer
description: The system shall provide a GitHubAnalyzer covering github.com and GHES sources.
acceptance_criteria: GitHubAnalyzer subclasses BaseAnalyzer | Reads via PyGithub against API_URL | Returns RepoAnalysis with GitHub-specific fields
notes: Supports both github.com and GHES base URLs

title: Azure DevOps source analyzer
description: The system shall provide an ADOAnalyzer covering Azure DevOps organizations and team projects.
acceptance_criteria: ADOAnalyzer enumerates repos via project | Returns RepoAnalysis | Resolves ADO repo UUIDs into amp:ado IDs
notes: Project optional; full org enumeration supported

title: Bitbucket Server source analyzer
description: The system shall provide a BitbucketAnalyzer covering on-prem Bitbucket Server / Data Center.
acceptance_criteria: BitbucketAnalyzer subclasses BaseAnalyzer | Targets the BBS REST 1.0 API | Resolves repos under a project
notes: Auth via BBS_PAT or username+password

title: Bitbucket Cloud source analyzer
description: The system shall provide a BitbucketCloudAnalyzer covering the bitbucket.org SaaS workspace API.
acceptance_criteria: BitbucketCloudAnalyzer subclasses BaseAnalyzer | Auth via BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN and BITBUCKET_EMAIL | Returns RepoAnalysis
notes: Uses workspace-scoped API tokens (not BBS PATs)

title: GitLab source analyzer
description: The system shall provide a GitLabAnalyzer covering GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab groups.
acceptance_criteria: GitLabAnalyzer subclasses BaseAnalyzer | Resolves groups recursively | Returns RepoAnalysis
notes: Auth via GITLAB_TOKEN

title: Empty source repo detection
description: The analyzer shall recognise a source repo with no commits and emit status:empty — via a pre-clone default-branch probe for most providers, and a post-clone zero commit/branch/tag check that also catches GitHub (whose REST API reports a default_branch even on an empty repo).
acceptance_criteria: Pre-clone is_empty_repo short-circuits the clone for null-default-branch providers | Post-clone check sets is_empty when commit/branch/tag counts are all zero | Empty repo carries only identity labels + status:empty | A clone failure routes to status:analysis-failed not status:empty
notes: GitHub reports a default_branch even on empty repos; the post-clone count check is the backstop

title: Repository size bucketing
description: The analyzer shall assign one of size:small/medium/large/huge based on byte thresholds 100MB / 1GB / 5GB.
acceptance_criteria: SIZE_SMALL=100MB SIZE_MEDIUM=1GB SIZE_LARGE=5GB | Exactly one size:* label emitted | size_bucket reflects repo_size_bytes
notes: Thresholds align with GEI archive limits

title: Pull-request count bucketing
description: The analyzer shall assign prs:small/medium/large/xlarge based on PR thresholds 100/500/5000.
acceptance_criteria: PR_SMALL=100 PR_MEDIUM=500 PR_LARGE=5000 | Exactly one prs:* label emitted | Threshold edges fall in lower bucket
notes: Predicts metadata-archive duration

title: Deep LFS check — gitattributes scan (root + nested + all refs)
description: The analyzer shall collect every .gitattributes (root and nested) across all branches and tags plus the full history to determine LFS configuration.
acceptance_criteria: ever_configured / currently_active / active_patterns set from all refs | Nested .gitattributes honored with directory scoping | Runs against the no-checkout clone via git plumbing
notes: Provider-agnostic; spans every ref not just HEAD

title: Deep LFS check — currently active
description: The analyzer shall inspect HEAD .gitattributes to determine if LFS is currently active.
acceptance_criteria: currently_active reflects HEAD .gitattributes | Active patterns recorded in LFSReport | Drives lfs:active label
notes: Distinct from historical patterns

title: Deep LFS check — tracked files inventory
description: The analyzer shall enumerate LFS-tracked files and their count via git lfs ls-files.
acceptance_criteria: tracked_file_count populated | Sample of tracked_files retained | Used to confirm lfs:active
notes: Bounded sample to keep reports small

title: Deep LFS check — pointer integrity fsck
description: The analyzer shall run git lfs fsck --pointers and surface malformed pointer errors.
acceptance_criteria: pointer_errors populated on malformed-pointer failure | Drives lfs:broken label | --pointers mode used because the no-checkout clone holds no LFS objects locally
notes: Object existence is verified server-side by AMP-F-ANL-091 instead

title: Deep LFS check — oversized non-LFS files
description: The analyzer shall flag raw blobs >100MB reachable from any branch tip that are not LFS-tracked.
acceptance_criteria: oversized_files populated for raw blobs >100MB at a tip | Drives lfs:oversized label | Scans the git object DB not the (empty) no-checkout working tree
notes: Object-DB scan works without a checkout

title: Deep LFS check — malformed gitattributes patterns
description: The analyzer shall flag LFS globs git silently ignores (e.g. brace expansion).
acceptance_criteria: invalid_attribute_patterns populated with file/pattern/reason | Drives lfs:attributes-invalid warning label | Detects brace expansion {*.tgz} and unmatched brackets
notes: Brace expansion is unsupported in .gitattributes

title: Deep LFS check — orphan LFS pointers
description: The analyzer shall flag LFS pointer blobs at paths no .gitattributes rule covers across any ref.
acceptance_criteria: orphan_pointers populated with path/size/ref_count | Drives lfs:orphan-pointers warning label | Honors root and nested .gitattributes coverage
notes: A later edit re-stores an orphan pointer as a raw blob

title: Deep LFS check — pointer/raw inconsistency
description: The analyzer shall flag paths that are an LFS pointer on some refs and a raw blob on others.
acceptance_criteria: inconsistent_paths populated with pointer/raw ref counts | Drives lfs:inconsistent warning label | Compares every branch and tag tip
notes: Split LFS state across the branch set

title: Deep LFS check — large raw blobs inventory
description: The analyzer shall inventory raw blobs >10MB reachable from any ref that ought to be LFS-tracked.
acceptance_criteria: large_raw_blobs and max_raw_blob_bytes populated from a git object-DB scan | LFS-coverage signal only — blob size labeling stays with blob:* | Only reachable blobs reported
notes: max_raw_blob_bytes feeds the post-migration raw-blob regression check

title: Deep LFS check — source object existence
description: The analyzer shall verify the source LFS server can serve every referenced OID via the Batch API.
acceptance_criteria: source_missing_oids populated when the source LFS server cannot serve an OID | Drives lfs:source-missing hard blocker | Endpoint resolved provider-agnostically via git lfs env
notes: Data-loss risk — nothing for the migration to transfer

title: Deep LFS check — storage size
description: The analyzer shall compute total LFS object storage in bytes.
acceptance_criteria: lfs_storage_bytes populated | Surfaced in markdown report | Predicts LFS-transfer cost
notes: Drives runtime estimates

title: Deep LFS check — server reachability
description: The analyzer shall probe the LFS server to confirm reachability before migration.
acceptance_criteria: server_reachable set True or False after probe | Unreachable server surfaced in report | Optional check skipped when no LFS active
notes: None when not run; True/False after probe

title: Submodule detection and rewrite gating
description: The analyzer shall detect .gitmodules entries and flag submodules:rewrite-needed when any URL points at the source SCM host.
acceptance_criteria: has_submodules True when .gitmodules present | submodules:rewrite-needed when source-SCM-hosted URL found | Submodule list retained in report
notes: Drives migration-fixes rewrite at destination

title: Cross-repo Actions workflow scan
description: The analyzer shall scan .github/workflows/*.yml uses: refs and emit actions:ok / actions:rewrite-needed / actions:none.
acceptance_criteria: actions:none when no workflow files | actions:rewrite-needed when non-whitelisted uses found | Marketplace owners actions/, github/, docker/ whitelisted
notes: Drives migration-fixes uses: rewrites

title: CODEOWNERS team-mention scan
description: The analyzer shall scan CODEOWNERS for @org/team mentions and emit codeowners:rewrite-needed or codeowners:none.
acceptance_criteria: codeowners:rewrite-needed when team mentions present | codeowners:none when CODEOWNERS absent | Mentions retained for migration-fixes resolver
notes: Resolver runs at post-migrate

title: Workflow secrets / vars / environments scan
description: The analyzer shall detect workflow references to secrets, variables, or environments and emit secrets:present.
acceptance_criteria: workflow_secrets, workflow_vars, workflow_environments populated | secrets:present emitted when any non-empty | GITHUB_TOKEN excluded from secrets list
notes: GEI does not migrate Actions secrets; manual recreate

title: Hardcoded URL scan (opt-in)
description: The analyzer shall, when --scan-hardcoded-urls is supplied, scan repo content for source-SCM URLs and emit hardcoded-urls:present.
acceptance_criteria: hardcoded_urls_scanned True only when flag passed | hardcoded-urls:present emitted only when hits found | Adds 1-30s per repo
notes: Opt-in; off by default for performance

title: GitHub branch protection scan
description: The analyzer shall capture classic branch protection rules at GitHub sources, emit branch-protection:present, and stash structured per-rule config in a hidden <!-- amp:branch-protection-data --> marker for post-migration recreate.
acceptance_criteria: branch_protection_rules populated for GitHub sources with {pattern
notes: config} | branch-protection:present emitted when any rule exists | Human table rendered in issue body | Hidden YAML marker emitted alongside table for the recreate path
column19: GitHub-source-only; GEI does not migrate these. Rulesets are out of scope.

title: GitHub custom-properties capture
description: The analyzer shall capture custom repository property values at GitHub sources and emit custom-properties:present.
acceptance_criteria: custom_properties populated for GitHub sources | custom-properties:present emitted when non-empty | Values retained for post-migrate apply
notes: Carried to destination by validate.apply_custom_properties_to_dest

title: Releases-oversized pre-flag
description: The analyzer shall pre-flag releases:oversized when release asset totals exceed 30 GB.
acceptance_criteria: RELEASES_OVERSIZED=30GB | releases:oversized when releases_total_bytes exceeds threshold | Predictive of GEI 40GB metadata cap
notes: Threshold leaves headroom for issues + PRs + comments

title: High-volume refs / tags / commits markers
description: The analyzer shall emit refs:high, tags:high, commits:huge when branch >5000, tag >5000, or commit >250000 counts are hit.
acceptance_criteria: REFS_HIGH=5000 TAGS_HIGH=5000 COMMITS_HUGE=250000 | Markers emitted only when threshold exceeded | Indicates GEI metadata-import timeout risk
notes: Operational hints for split / archive

title: Invalid / long ref-name detection
description: The analyzer shall detect refs >255 chars and refs containing characters disallowed by git check-ref-format.
acceptance_criteria: REF_MAX_LENGTH=255 | ref:long emitted for >255 char refs | ref:invalid-chars for refs matching _INVALID_REF_CHARS
notes: Drives BBS / GitLab pre-migration cleanup

title: Clone timeout configurable
description: The analyzer's per-clone git clone --mirror shall time out after 1800s by default, overridable via AMP_CLONE_TIMEOUT.
acceptance_criteria: CLONE_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT=1800 | AMP_CLONE_TIMEOUT integer env override honored | Invalid override falls back to default
notes: 30-min default tolerates size:huge clones

title: Status label state machine
description: The platform shall maintain mutually-exclusive status:* labels grouped into stages: analyze, dryrun, migrate, archive, repair, lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: STATUS_STAGES maps every status:* to a stage | set_status_label only clears same-stage peers | Each stage outcome preserved independently
notes: Failure at later stage never wipes earlier success

title: set_status_label clears same-stage peers only
description: The platform shall replace only the prior label of the same stage when set_status_label is called.
acceptance_criteria: Same-stage peers removed | Other stages' labels untouched | Adds the new label if not already present
notes: Inline project sync runs after change

title: clear_status_stage drops all same-stage labels
description: The platform shall provide clear_status_stage to drop every status:* label in a stage on exit (e.g. /unarchive).
acceptance_criteria: Every status:* in stage removed | Used when no replacement label applies | Distinct from set_status_label
notes: Required for archive stage exit

title: Command labels trigger workflow dispatch
description: The platform shall treat cmd:* labels as triggers that fire label-ops.yml, which posts the equivalent /command comment.
acceptance_criteria: Each cmd:* has a dispatch step in label-ops.yml | label-ops posts /command via peter-evans/create-or-update-comment | Indirection enables bulk label edits
notes: Bridge to /command preserves single dispatch path

title: cmd:* labels cleared after dispatch
description: The platform shall remove the cmd:* label after the dispatch comment is posted to keep labels as triggers, not state.
acceptance_criteria: Final step in label-ops.yml removes the cmd:* label | Re-applying the same label re-triggers the workflow | Other labels untouched
notes: Allows reuse of the same trigger label

title: Analysis labels capture extracted state
description: The platform shall apply analysis labels (size:*, blob:*, lfs:*, submodules*, actions:*, codeowners:*, secrets:*) reflecting analyzer output.
acceptance_criteria: Each analysis dimension produces exactly one or zero labels | Labels match RepoAnalysis state | Set during analyze and re-analyze
notes: Source-of-truth via config/labels.yml

title: Routing labels feed migrate handlers
description: The platform shall extract dst-org:, dst-team:, and dst-prefix: labels from the issue to feed migrate and upsert-teams handlers.
acceptance_criteria: target_org parsed from dst-org: label | target_team from dst-team: | prefix from dst-prefix: | Multiple-of-same-family marked as conflict
notes: Single-issue conflict surfaces in command output

title: PRESERVE_PREFIXES_DEFAULT honored on re-analysis
description: The platform shall preserve labels with prefixes status:, cmd:, cfg:, dst-, cp-repair-, provider:, duration:, migration-fixes:, custom-properties:applied/created/dest-not-set during re-analysis.
acceptance_criteria: PRESERVE_PREFIXES_DEFAULT tuple contains all human-driven prefixes | replace_metadata_labels keeps these prefixes | New analysis labels merged with kept set
notes: Refuses to clear if final label set empty

title: AMP ID injected in body and title
description: The platform shall embed the AMP ID twice — as a · <amp_id> title suffix and a hidden <!-- amp-id: ... --> body marker.
acceptance_criteria: inject_into_title appends suffix replacing existing | inject_into_body inserts HTML comment marker | Body marker is canonical source of truth
notes: Survives hand-edits of the title

title: AMP ID stable across renames
description: The platform shall use the AMP ID for re-analysis and refresh, never name-based lookup, so renames don't fork issues.
acceptance_criteria: from_title parses suffix | from_body parses HTML comment | Refresh resolves issue via amp_id rather than repo name
notes: Provider-prefixed (gh:, ado:, gl:, bb:, bbc:)

title: Refuse to clear all labels on metadata replace
description: The platform shall refuse to apply an empty label set during metadata replacement to prevent accidental wipes.
acceptance_criteria: replace_metadata_labels returns empty list when nothing to set | Issue labels left untouched | Warning logged
notes: Defensive against analyzer bugs producing zero labels

title: Inline project sync after label change
description: The platform shall sync the GitHub Project v2 Status field inline after status:* or metadata-label changes.
acceptance_criteria: set_status_label calls sync_issue_status inline | replace_metadata_labels also syncs inline | Cron sweeper backstops UI edits
notes: Avoids per-label runner allocation overhead

title: IssueOps comment dispatcher
description: The platform shall parse /command comments on AMP issues and route to handlers in amp/commands/.
acceptance_criteria: issue-ops.yml parses comment body | dispatch routes to matching handler | Unknown command posts failure comment
notes: Single entry point for all IssueOps commands

title: /dryrun command
description: The platform shall accept /dryrun on an AMP issue to enqueue a sandbox migration against vars.SANDBOX_ORG.
acceptance_criteria: Posts blocker when SANDBOX_ORG unset | Stamps status:dryrun-queued or runs directly when queue off | Idempotent for status:dryrun-running/-queued
notes: Routes through queue by default

title: /migrate command
description: The platform shall accept /migrate on an AMP issue to enqueue a production GEI migration to the dst-org.
acceptance_criteria: Blocks on missing dst-org or conflicts | Stamps status:migrate-queued or runs directly | Idempotent for already-running/queued | Re-run on a prior migrate-success preserves the success label when GEI emits 'No operation will be performed' (destination still exists)
notes: Empty-repo blockers surfaced as comment. Idempotent re-run guard at amp/commands/__init__.py _handle_migrate failure branch; first-time hit of same marker without prior success still stamps migrate-failed.

title: /migrate-with-submodules command
description: The platform shall accept /migrate-with-submodules on an AMP issue to enqueue /migrate for the parent and each AMP-managed direct submodule; the parent issue receives a single aggregated status comment that each child worker updates in place as it finishes; skipped submodules carry a categorised reason and already-migrated siblings show destination repo age.
acceptance_criteria: Enqueues parent via _handle_enqueue_migrate | Resolves each submodule URL via IssueIndex | Pre-checks destination existence and surfaces age (created_at/pushed_at) | Posts tracker comment on each queued child (amp-submodule-of marker) | Posts aggregated status comment on parent (amp-submodule-status + amp-submodule-data JSON payload markers) | Child workers re-render the parent comment from child status labels on completion (idempotent under concurrent writes) | Skipped siblings categorised: unparseable-url / no-amp-issue / ambiguous / self-reference / label-error | Re-runs post a fresh aggregated comment (older summaries are audit trail)
notes: One-level deep; siblings without matching AMP issue listed under Skipped with reason

title: /migrate-submodules-deep command
description: The platform shall accept /migrate-submodules-deep on an AMP issue to enqueue /migrate for the parent and every AMP-managed descendant resolved by recursively walking the submodule tree (children, grandchildren, and deeper); the traversal is cycle-safe and de-duplicated so a submodule cycle or a repo shared by two parents is queued once; reporting (aggregated status comment, skip-reason categories, already-migrated age) matches /migrate-with-submodules.
acceptance_criteria: Resolves the full descendant tree via a BFS over the IssueIndex snapshot | Each unique descendant queued via cmd:migrate exactly once | Cycles / back-edges to an ancestor terminate without looping | A submodule shared by two repos (diamond) is queued once | Aggregated status comment stamped with the /migrate-submodules-deep command name | Skip reasons categorised identically to the one-level command and de-duplicated by URL | No extra API calls beyond the single issue-index scan
notes: Recursive variant of AMP-F-IOP-017; one-level command unchanged

title: /remigrate command
description: The platform shall accept /remigrate to delete the destination repo and re-run /migrate.
acceptance_criteria: Adds cmd-pending:remigrate marker first | Stamps status:migrate-queued | Worker deletes destination before migrate
notes: Two-step label apply guarded by reconciler 5-min orphan rule

title: /archive command
description: The platform shall accept /archive to archive/lock/read-only the source repo per provider.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches per-provider archive helper | Posts result comment | Stamps status:archiving / status:archived
notes: BBS uses readOnly setting; GH/GL/ADO use archive

title: /unarchive command
description: The platform shall accept /unarchive to reverse archive on the source and clear status:archived.
acceptance_criteria: Calls per-provider unarchive helper | Drops status:archived via clear_status_stage | Re-stamps status:migrate-success when appropriate
notes: Provider-specific reversal endpoints

title: /upsert-teams command
description: The platform shall create <base>-read/-write/-admin teams from dst-team: and attach them to the destination repo via /upsert-teams (formerly /attach-teams).
acceptance_criteria: Creates missing teams idempotently | Attaches read/write/admin permissions | Posts summary comment | Stamps upserted:teams on success
notes: dst-team: label drives base name

title: /set-properties command
description: The platform shall apply custom property JSON to the destination repo via /set-properties --props '{...}'.
acceptance_criteria: Parses --props JSON | Calls PUT custom-properties API | Reports per-property result
notes: GHEC and GHEC-DR via dest client

title: /configure-autolink command
description: The platform shall configure ADO autolink references on the destination via /configure-autolink.
acceptance_criteria: Creates autolink reference on destination | ADO-only provider | Idempotent on existing references
notes: Resolves AB#123 etc into ADO work item URLs

title: Mannequin reclamation (org-wide)
description: The platform shall remap mannequin users created by GEI org-wide via the Reclaim Mannequins workflow and the amp reclaim-mannequins CLI.
acceptance_criteria: Generates unmapped CSV via gh gei generate-mannequin-csv | Operator fills target column | Calls gh gei reclaim-mannequin once per destination org | Single org-wide pass
notes: Org-scoped; CSV produced by companion Generate Mannequin CSV step

title: /update-issue command
description: The platform shall accept /update-issue to re-run analysis and refresh the issue body and labels in place.
acceptance_criteria: Re-runs analyzer for the AMP-ID repo | Refreshes body, title, labels | Preserves PRESERVE_PREFIXES_DEFAULT
notes: Same code path as scheduled refresh

title: Blocker handling posts comment
description: The platform shall post a structured blocker comment whenever a command cannot proceed (missing dst-org, conflicting labels, empty repo).
acceptance_criteria: Comment lists each blocker as a bullet | No state change when blocked | Suggestions for remediation included
notes: Surfaces destination-conflict / preflight failures

title: Destination-conflict detection
description: The platform shall detect multiple dst-org:, dst-team:, or dst-prefix: labels and refuse to proceed.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple same-family labels collected as conflicts | Blocker comment lists each conflict family | /dryrun and /migrate both gated
notes: Forces operator to disambiguate before migration

title: Empty-repo guard
description: The platform shall block /dryrun, /migrate, and /remigrate on issues labeled status:empty.
acceptance_criteria: _empty_repo_blockers returns non-empty when status:empty | Comment posted instead of dispatch | No queued/running state
notes: Avoids wasting GEI capacity on empty sources

title: cmd:* → /command bridge in label-ops
description: The platform shall translate cmd:* label application into the equivalent /command comment via label-ops.yml.
acceptance_criteria: Each cmd:* has dispatch step posting /command | Final step removes the cmd:* label | App token preferred, GH_DEST_PAT fallback
notes: Indirection lets labels be bulk-editable

title: AI failure analysis on command failure
description: The platform shall run the AI advisor when issue-ops.yml's Execute command step fails.
acceptance_criteria: AI Failure Analysis step runs on failure() of Execute | Advisor posts comment with diagnosis | Logs uploaded as artifact
notes: 3-tier advisor; rules then LLM tool-use then heuristic

title: Workflow log artifact upload
description: The platform shall upload migration logs as an artifact named migration-logs-<issue-number>.
acceptance_criteria: Logs uploaded via actions/upload-artifact@v4 | Artifact name embeds issue number | Available for advisor and post-hoc review
notes: Survives runner cleanup

title: control-repo client used for dispatch
description: The platform shall use the control-repo GitHub client (App / GITHUB_TOKEN) for IssueOps dispatch, never GH_DEST_PAT.
acceptance_criteria: dispatch calls get_control_github_client | Token domains separated by design | Cross-tenant safe
notes: GH_DEST_PAT is destination-only

title: Queue on by default
description: The migration queue shall be enabled unless AMP_QUEUE_ENABLED is explicitly set to the literal string false.
acceptance_criteria: _queue_enabled returns False only when env equals 'false' case-insensitive | Anything else leaves queue enabled | Typos fail safe to enabled
notes: Opt-out only; fail-safe to capacity-aware

title: Queue label stamping
description: The queue handlers shall stamp status:dryrun-queued or status:migrate-queued instead of running the command directly.
acceptance_criteria: status:*-queued applied via set_status_label | Comment posted noting Queued | No GEI subprocess spawned at enqueue time
notes: Worker fires later when slot is free

title: Dispatcher wakes on queue events
description: The dispatcher shall wake on status:*-queued labeling, worker completion, manual run, and an opt-in hourly weekday cron (enabled via AMP_DISPATCHER_CRON_ENABLED=true; off by default).
acceptance_criteria: cron 0 * * * 1-5 configured | scheduled trigger gated by vars.AMP_DISPATCHER_CRON_ENABLED == 'true' | issues:labeled with status:*-queued triggers run regardless of cron var | workflow_run on Migration Worker triggers run regardless of cron var
notes: Cron is opt-in safety net; event-driven triggers always fire

title: Capacity-aware claim FIFO
description: The dispatcher shall claim up to cap-running items per tick, oldest first, ordered by createdAt.
acceptance_criteria: SLOTS = CAP - (migrate-running + dryrun-running) | Queued issues listed with createdAt | Earliest queued claimed first
notes: Cap shared across migrate and dryrun

title: Worker per claim
description: The dispatcher shall spawn one migration-worker.yml run per claimed issue, never batched.
acceptance_criteria: One workflow_dispatch per claim | Comment posted noting claim and run URL | Run-name embeds issue number
notes: One-issue-per-runner isolation

title: Status:*-running stamped at claim
description: The dispatcher shall replace status:*-queued with status:*-running atomically before posting the claim comment.
acceptance_criteria: Queued label removed and running label added | Claim comment posted | Same label transition under single-flight concurrency lock
notes: Single-flight prevents double-claim

title: Reconciler re-queues stuck running issues
description: The reconciler shall re-queue any status:*-running label aged >120 minutes with no live Migration Worker run.
acceptance_criteria: MIGRATE_STUCK_THRESHOLD_MIN default 120 | Live worker list scraped from gh run list | Stuck running flipped back to queued with comment
notes: Tolerates long migrations; default ~2h

title: Reconciler strips orphaned cmd-pending:remigrate
description: The reconciler shall strip cmd-pending:remigrate from issues without a matching status:migrate-queued/-running after a 5-minute grace period.
acceptance_criteria: ORPHAN_THRESHOLD_MIN=5 | Marker stripped only when no queue/running label present | Grace tolerates two-step enqueue race
notes: Avoids permanent re-migrate flag on retried issues

title: Idempotent duplicate-trigger handling
description: The enqueue handlers shall warn-and-ignore when the issue already has the queued or running status for the same command.
acceptance_criteria: WARNING comment posted via _post_already_active | No additional label change | Subsequent trigger replays safely
notes: Stops duplicate workers from same operator action

title: Single-flight dispatcher concurrency
description: The dispatcher workflow shall use concurrency: to ensure only one dispatch tick runs at a time.
acceptance_criteria: concurrency group serializes dispatcher runs | Prevents double-claim across overlapping triggers | Cancel-in-progress not set (queueing semantics)
notes: Critical for FIFO correctness

title: Push migration-fixes branch post-migrate
description: The system shall push an `amp/migration-fixes` branch to the destination repo after `/dryrun` or `/migrate` success and open a pull request for it.
acceptance_criteria: Triggered automatically after status:migrate-success or status:dryrun-success | Branch name is `amp/migration-fixes` | Branch pushed via Git Data API | A best-effort idempotent pull request is opened for the branch (existing open PR reused; `pr_url` left empty when PR creation fails)
notes: Best-effort: failures never roll back the underlying migration

title: Build branch via Git Data API only
description: The system shall build the migration-fixes commit using the GitHub Contents and Git Data APIs without cloning the destination repo.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation uses PyGithub Contents API for reads | InputGitTreeElement used for commit tree | No `git clone` or temp directory created
notes: Avoids large-repo network/disk cost on the destination

title: Rewrite submodule URLs to destination
description: The system shall rewrite `.gitmodules` URLs pointing at AMP-managed sibling source repos to their destination coordinates.
acceptance_criteria: Only siblings present in the AMP issue index are rewritten | Non-AMP-managed URLs are left unchanged and listed as skipped | Relative path URLs (../sibling.git) are not flagged as skipped | Original URL scheme (ssh/https) preserved; only host/org/repo rewritten
notes: Marketplace/non-sibling URLs untouched

title: Rewrite workflow uses references
description: The system shall rewrite cross-repo `uses:` references in `.github/workflows/*.yml` to destination owner/repo when the target is AMP-managed.
acceptance_criteria: Marketplace owners actions/, github/, docker/ are never rewritten | Leading whitespace, quoting, and trailing comments preserved byte-identically | Pinned ref/sha is preserved verbatim
notes: Whitelist is _DEFAULT_WHITELIST

title: Rewrite CODEOWNERS team mentions
description: The system shall rewrite `@<src_org>/<team>` mentions in CODEOWNERS files to `@<dst_org>/<team>` when the source org is AMP-managed.
acceptance_criteria: Three locations checked: CODEOWNERS, .github/CODEOWNERS, docs/CODEOWNERS | Mentions inside comment lines (`#`) are not rewritten | Team existence at destination is NOT checked; missing teams created later via /upsert-teams
notes: Source org must have ≥1 AMP-managed repo to resolve dst-org

title: Resolve siblings via IssueIndex
description: The system shall build a one-pass IssueIndex of AMP issues filtered by `provider:` label to resolve sibling source URLs to destination coordinates.
acceptance_criteria: Index built once per push (not per lookup) | Lookups are pure dict reads after construction | Bitbucket Server `scm/<project>/<repo>` paths handled by stripping `scm` segment
notes: Resolves both by amp_id and (provider, scope, repo_lower) fallback

title: Sandbox prefix during dryrun
description: The system shall emit `dryrun-` prefixed destination repo names when computing migration-fixes in sandbox/dryrun mode.
acceptance_criteria: `sandbox=True` causes resolver to return `dryrun-<dst_repo>` URLs | Dryrun preview matches what /migrate will produce
notes: Preview faithfulness for operator review

title: Stamp migration-fixes outcome labels
description: The system shall stamp one of `migration-fixes:pushed`, `migration-fixes:none`, or `migration-fixes:failed` on the AMP issue after each migration-fixes attempt.
acceptance_criteria: `migration-fixes:pushed` when ≥1 file changed and branch pushed | `migration-fixes:none` when no rewrites needed or destination empty | `migration-fixes:failed` includes a comment with the error
notes: Stale branch deleted when no rewrites are needed

title: Skip when destination has no default branch
description: The system shall treat an empty destination repo (no default branch) as `migration-fixes:none` rather than a failure.
acceptance_criteria: `DestinationEmpty` exception routes to skipped_empty=True | Migration-fixes does not double-report what branch/tag/commit count checks already flag
notes: The underlying migration's emptiness is the real signal

title: Force-update existing migration-fixes branch
description: The system shall force-update an existing `amp/migration-fixes` ref to the new commit because AMP owns the branch by convention.
acceptance_criteria: Existing ref is force-edited to new commit SHA | Missing ref is created via create_git_ref | Branch URL returned in result for issue comment
notes: Humans rebase via the PR if they want to retain edits

title: Best-effort post-migration
description: Post-migration write steps (migration-fixes, custom properties, environments, secret/variable stubs, branch protection) shall never roll back or fail the underlying migration; a step that does not fully land surfaces as a warning, not a migration failure.
source_reference: amp/migration_verify.py — best-effort check builders + VerificationReport.overall_ok; amp/commands/__init__.py — _handle_migrate verification branch
acceptance_criteria: Best-effort write-step failures render as `warn` CheckResults | `warn` does not flip `VerificationReport.overall_ok` | `status:migrate-success` + `status:has-warnings` stamped (never `status:migrate-failed`) | Only content/structural check failures (counts/SHAs/clone) fail the migration
notes: Aligns the implementation with the long-standing best-effort intent

title: Validate source vs destination counts
description: The system shall compare source branch/tag/commit counts and first/last-commit SHAs against the destination repo and stamp `status:validate-passed` or `status:validate-failed`.
acceptance_criteria: Source-side values come from the pre-migration baseline when valid; otherwise from a live source clone | Destination side from live clone | `status:validate-passed` when no structural mismatches; `status:validate-failed` lists each delta
notes: GitHub and Bitbucket Cloud sources — verification resolves source clone URLs for both

title: Capture source baseline before GEI starts
description: The system shall capture a refs-only snapshot of the source repo (branches/tags/default branch/commit count/first+last SHA) immediately before launching GEI and persist it to a hidden marker on the AMP issue body.
acceptance_criteria: `git clone --bare --filter=blob:none` runs in parallel with GEI | Marker format `<!-- amp:source-baseline: {json} -->` is parseable round-trip | Verifier uses the baseline instead of live source values when available | Capture failure degrades gracefully to live source comparison
notes: Hides drift from team commits during the migration window

title: Source freeze advisory check
description: The verification report shall include a `Source freeze` check that emits 🟨 when source drifted between baseline capture and verification (branches added/deleted; default-branch tip moved).
acceptance_criteria: Compares baseline vs live source clone | ✅ when source unchanged during migration | 🟨 (advisory) when source moved; details list adds/removes/tip change | Never fails the run — surfaces freeze violations without blocking
notes: Calls out team violations of the source-freeze policy

title: Exclude migration-fixes branch from count
description: The validator shall exclude the `amp/migration-fixes` branch from the destination branch count.
acceptance_criteria: Branches starting with `amp/` or `gh-readonly-queue/` are filtered out of both sides | Mismatch message notes the exclusion
notes: Prevents AMP's own branch from failing the assertion

title: Skip commit-count when history rewritten
description: The system shall skip the commit-count and SHA assertions and stamp `status:validate-history-rewritten` when LFS-related history rewrite is detected.
acceptance_criteria: Trigger label: `lfs:oversized` only (operator runs `git lfs migrate import`/`filter-repo` before push) | `lfs:active` and `lfs:historical` no longer skip — AMP's LFS path preserves commit SHAs | Branch and tag count assertions still run | `status:validate-history-rewritten` label applied when history_rewritten=True
notes: SHAs are expected to differ after history rewrite

title: Carry custom properties to destination
description: The system shall apply analyze-time custom property values to the destination repo via REST PATCH `/repos/{org}/{repo}/properties/values`.
acceptance_criteria: Properties parsed from `### Custom Properties` table in issue body | Bulk PATCH attempted first; per-property fallback on 422 | `custom-properties:applied` label on success
notes: GitHub source only — custom properties are a GitHub feature

title: Auto-create destination property schema on 422
description: The system shall attempt to create missing property schema at the destination org via `PATCH /orgs/{org}/properties/schema` when a value PATCH 422s.
acceptance_criteria: Per-property retry after schema create | `custom-properties:created+applied` when schema was created and value set | Schema payload built with safe defaults (string, no allowed_values)
notes: Recovers from "property not defined for this organization"

title: Stamp custom-properties outcome label
description: The system shall stamp `custom-properties:applied`, `custom-properties:created+applied`, or `custom-properties:dest-not-set` on the AMP issue after carry-through.
acceptance_criteria: `custom-properties:dest-not-set` when any property failed | Failed properties are listed by name with reason in issue comment | Label set independently of validation outcome
notes: Migration's `migrate-success` preserved regardless of carry-through

title: Three-tier team creation in destination
description: The system shall ensure `<base>-read` (pull), `<base>-write` (push), and `<base>-admin` (admin) teams exist in the destination org and attach the migrated repo.
acceptance_criteria: Only runs when `dst-team:<base>` label is set | Falls back to get_team_by_slug on create 422 (SCIM/already-exists) | Each team attached with the matching permission
notes: Invoked automatically by post-migrate.yml after status:migrate-success

title: Idempotent open-or-get PR for fixes branch
description: The system shall return the URL of an existing open PR for `amp/migration-fixes` rather than 422 when re-pushing on /dryrun.
acceptance_criteria: Re-running /dryrun does not error on duplicate PR | Lookup uses `<owner>:amp/migration-fixes` head selector | Best-effort: returns empty string on lookup failure
notes: PR opening is best-effort; branch push is the canonical signal

title: Disable migration-fixes via env var
description: The system shall skip the migration-fixes push when `AMP_DISABLE_MIGRATION_FIXES=true` is set in the environment.
acceptance_criteria: Case-insensitive literal "true" disables | Function returns None and skips label stamp | Logged at INFO
notes: Opt-out for emergency disable

title: Sync status label to Project Status field
description: The system shall sync the migration issue's current `status:*` label to the GitHub Projects v2 Status single-select field.
acceptance_criteria: Mapping table STATUS_LABEL_TO_PROJECT used | Labels not in mapping are intentional no-ops (preserving prior column) | Best-effort; failures logged WARNING and swallowed
notes: Labels remain the source of truth; project fields are derived

title: Convergent priority resolver
description: The system shall pick the highest-priority `status:*` label by STATUS_PRIORITY when multiple status labels coexist, to remain idempotent under webhook reordering.
acceptance_criteria: Terminal states beat transient ones (archived > migrate-success > migrate-running) | Reading current labels (not the event's label) makes sync convergent | `status:repairing` deliberately excluded; previous column preserved
notes: Handles out-of-order issues.labeled webhooks

title: Drag-to-trigger maps columns to cmd labels
description: The system shall apply a `cmd:*` label to the issue when a card is dragged into one of the trigger columns (Dry Run, Migrate, Archive).
acceptance_criteria: Dry Run → cmd:dryrun; Migrate → cmd:migrate; Archive → cmd:archive | Other columns are visibility-only no-ops | cmd:* label flows through label-ops.yml chain unchanged
notes: Trigger map kept consistent with cmd:* in config/labels.yml

title: Loop prevention on drag trigger
description: The system shall require the project_v2_item.edited webhook `sender.type == 'User'` before applying a cmd:* label.
acceptance_criteria: Forward-sync's own mutations (made by the App) are filtered out | Prevents infinite loop between drag-to-trigger and sync-project-status | Workflow-level `if:` gate
notes: Bot/App-driven mutations short-circuit before runner allocation

title: Configure project is destructive
description: The `configure-project` command shall destructively replace all Status field options and require `--force` to run.
acceptance_criteria: GraphQL updateProjectV2Field has no non-destructive option-add | `--force` flag mandatory at CLI layer | Idempotent across re-runs; dynamic fields preserve operator-supplied options
notes: One-shot operator setup command

title: Project config gated by repo vars
description: The project sync workflow shall short-circuit before runner allocation when `AMP_PROJECT_OWNER` or `AMP_PROJECT_NUMBER` is empty.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow `if:` checks both vars are non-empty | sync_issue_status returns silently when target unset | No billing for installs without a project
notes: Default-off; opt-in by setting both repo vars

title: Backfill sweeper cron for drift
description: The system shall run `backfill-project-status` hourly during US-Eastern business hours weekdays to reconcile label/project drift.
acceptance_criteria: Cron `0 10-23 * * 1-5` UTC (M-F, ~6am-7pm ET) | Concurrency group prevents overlapping sweeps | Catches direct-UI label edits that bypassed the CLI
notes: No DST handling, no weekends — by design

title: GHEC-DR routing via _graphql_url
description: The system shall route Projects v2 GraphQL calls through `$GH_DEST_API_URL/graphql` when the env var is set.
acceptance_criteria: `_graphql_url()` builds from GH_DEST_API_URL or defaults to api.github.com | All GraphQL mutations honor the routing | Backfill workflow propagates GH_DEST_API_URL env var
notes: Required for cross-tenant Projects v2 access

title: Inline sync on label set
description: The system shall sync the project board inline whenever the CLI mutates a `status:*` label via `set_status_label`.
acceptance_criteria: In-process call from amp.labels.set_status_label | Board updates within seconds of label change | Eliminates per-event workflow billing cost
notes: Cron sweeper acts only as drift catch-up

title: Steady-state sweep emits zero mutations
description: The backfill sweeper shall skip already-correct field values to emit zero mutations per unchanged issue.
acceptance_criteria: `existing_field_values` snapshot compared per field | No-op when desired == current | Reduces GraphQL quota burn on the sweeper
notes: Sweep complexity scales with churn, not issue count

title: Skip status:repairing in sync
description: The status sync shall leave the project column unchanged when the current top-priority label is `status:repairing`.
acceptance_criteria: `status:repairing` deliberately absent from STATUS_PRIORITY | Prior column preserved while auto-repair runs | Transient state not modeled on the Kanban
notes: Repair completion restores a terminal status which then syncs

title: Best-effort failure swallowing
description: The system shall log project-sync failures at WARNING and never block a migration.
acceptance_criteria: InsufficientScopesError logged once at module level | RequestException/RuntimeError swallowed with label context | Status label set succeeds even when sync fails
notes: Labels are the source of truth; project state is derived

title: Tier 1 deterministic rule matching
description: The advisor shall match logs against `config/failure_rules.yml` patterns and return a Tier 1 result when confidence ≥ 90.
acceptance_criteria: First-matching rule wins (rules ordered by priority in YAML) | Confidence threshold ≥ 90 short-circuits AI tiers | Returns RuleMatch with slug, confidence, fix markdown, extra_labels
notes: Rules below 90 fall through to Tier 2

title: Tier 2 LLM tool-use loop
description: The advisor shall run a multi-turn LLM tool-use loop with at most 8 turns when Tier 1 is inconclusive.
acceptance_criteria: MAX_TURNS = 8 | Each turn may invoke a tool from TOOL_REGISTRY or emit final analysis JSON | Loop exits early on `root_cause` response
notes: Bounded to keep latency and token cost predictable

title: Six-tool Tier 2 registry
description: The advisor shall expose exactly these tools to the LLM: search_logs, get_issue_details, check_repo_exists, check_ref_names, check_lfs_status, get_api_rate_limit.
acceptance_criteria: TOOL_REGISTRY contains exactly these 6 keys | Each entry has function, description, parameters | search_logs returns first 50 matches max
notes: Adding a new tool requires updating both the function and registry

title: Tier 3 heuristic fallback
description: The advisor shall return a heuristic-based result with confidence 50 when both Tier 1 and Tier 2 fail to produce a diagnosis.
acceptance_criteria: Heuristic patterns: already exist, 401, 403, not found, rate limit, timeout, lfs | Returns slug `unknown` at confidence 20 when nothing matches | Tier 3 label flagged as WARNING in posted comment
notes: Always returns a result; never None

title: 72-hour advisor cache TTL
description: The advisor shall cache diagnosis results in `~/.cache/amp/advisor/` keyed by issue and logs hash for 72 hours.
acceptance_criteria: CACHE_TTL_HOURS = 72 | Cache key derived from issue number and md5(logs) | Cache miss/decode errors are silent
notes: Reduces LLM cost on repeated diagnoses

title: Repairs target -fixed companion repo
description: The system shall push auto-repairs to a `<repo>-fixed` companion repo and never modify the source repo in place.
acceptance_criteria: `FIXED_SUFFIX = "-fixed"` appended to source repo name | Companion repo created at source provider before push | Retry runs against the -fixed repo, never the original
notes: Source repo invariance is a non-negotiable constraint

title: Never auto-delete a destination repo
description: The advisor shall NEVER auto-delete an existing destination repo on a `repo-already-exists` failure; no repair handler is registered for the slug. It diagnoses the failure, posts the manual remedy (`/remigrate` or a different target name), and leaves the issue in `*-failed`.
acceptance_criteria: `can_repair('repo-already-exists')` returns false → `attempt_repair` returns None | Auto-delete destroyed data: no `-fixed` repo meant no retry, so a deleted repo stayed gone | Operator decides via `/remigrate` (deletes intentionally) or a new target name
notes: Changed 2026-05 — previously auto-deleted on /migrate failures; an existing destination is never destroyed without an explicit operator command

title: Token fallback chain for AI client
description: The AI client shall resolve tokens in order MODELS_TOKEN → GITHUB_TOKEN → Copilot SDK (logged-in user).
acceptance_criteria: `_get_token` returns (token, transport) with transport in {models, copilot} | Models endpoint is GitHub Models inference URL | Copilot SDK requires `pip install copilot` and falls back when no token is set
notes: Same source as the Tier 4 token table in CLAUDE.md

title: Advisor exits 0 on transient 403/429
description: The advisor CLI shall exit 0 on transient 403 or 429 from `get_repo` so the original command's failure status comment is not buried.
acceptance_criteria: GithubException with status in (403, 429) logs WARNING and returns | Parent workflow's "Fail job if execute failed" gate still fires | Prevents double-failure with Python stack trace
notes: Failure-cascade hardening

title: Apply cp-failreason-<slug> label
description: The advisor shall apply a `cp-failreason-<slug>` label to the issue after each diagnosis.
acceptance_criteria: Label derived from result.slug (kebab-case) | Extra labels from Tier 1 rule also applied | Tier 3 fallback diagnosis status = WARNING; Tier 1/2 = SUCCESS
notes: Failure taxonomy externalized to labels for export pivots

title: JSON response with retry-on-parse-fail
description: The AI client shall request `response_format=json_object` on Tier 2 first attempt and retry with a correction prompt if the response is not valid JSON.
acceptance_criteria: max_retries default 2 | Markdown code fences stripped before json.loads | Second attempt prompts the model to emit valid JSON only
notes: Hardens against models that wrap JSON in markdown

title: `/advise` CLI command for on-demand analysis
description: The system shall expose `amp advise --issue <n> --repo <slug>` for on-demand failure analysis from an operator's terminal.
acceptance_criteria: Terminal format prints markdown to stdout | `--format md` posts comment to issue and applies labels | Auto-repair runs by default unless logs flag disables
notes: Same advisor pipeline as the automatic post-failure path

title: Auto-repair invoked on diagnosed failure
description: The advisor shall invoke `attempt_repair` automatically when `can_repair(slug)` returns true and auto-repair is enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Sets `status:repairing` while repair runs and clears after | Successful repair applies `cp-repair-applied` and removes `cp-repair-available` | Failed repair restores the prior `*-failed` status
notes: Retry happens automatically against the -fixed repo on success

title: Retry against -fixed repo
description: The system shall retry the original failed operation (dryrun or migrate) against the `<repo>-fixed` source repo after a successful auto-repair.
acceptance_criteria: Determines original operation from status:*-failed labels | Re-runs gei/ado2gh/bbs2gh against fixed_repo | Posts /retry-dryrun or /retry-migrate comment with outcome
notes: 60-minute subprocess timeout; failures preserved as *-failed

title: Clear stale cp-repair-* labels on new attempt
description: The platform shall remove any existing `cp-repair-available` and `cp-repair-applied` labels at the start of a new `/dryrun`, `/migrate`, or `/remigrate` (queued or direct) so a stale repair proposal from a prior failure does not linger while a fresh attempt is in flight.
acceptance_criteria: clear_cp_repair_labels invoked before set_status_label transitions to *-running or *-queued | Blocker short-circuits leave prior cp-repair-* labels intact (no transition occurred) | Already-running/queued issues are not re-cleared | Advisor re-stamps cp-repair-* if the new attempt also fails
notes: Avoids stale repair signal on the Kanban and in exports between attempts

title: Generate daily activity report
description: The system shall generate a daily migration activity report covering the previous 24-hour window grouped by stage.
acceptance_criteria: Categories: analyzed, dryrun_success, dryrun_failed, migrate_success, migrate_failed, archived, in_progress, ai_diagnosed, blockers | Cumulative per-provider pivot included | terminal/md output formats supported
notes: `amp daily --discussion` posts to General Discussion category

title: Daily report scheduled 6pm UTC weekdays
description: The Daily Report workflow shall run on cron `0 18 * * 1-5` (6pm UTC, Monday-Friday).
acceptance_criteria: Cron expression literal `0 18 * * 1-5` | workflow_dispatch input `date` for ad-hoc backfill | App token minted best-effort for cross-tenant control-repo read
notes: No weekend runs; manual trigger always available

title: Post daily report as Discussion
description: The system shall post the daily report as a new GitHub Discussion in the default `General` category when `--discussion` is set.
acceptance_criteria: Falls back to first available category if General is missing | Token must carry `discussions: write` | Discussion URL echoed to stdout/logs
notes: Daily report scheduled run posts to Discussions automatically

title: Dashboard terminal summary
description: The system shall print a migration dashboard summary grouping open issues by `status:*` and `provider:*` plus blockers and AI counts.
acceptance_criteria: Total open issue count | Per-status and per-provider tallies | Counts blockers (blob:error, lfs:broken), AI diagnoses (cp-failreason-*), and repairs (cp-repair-*)
notes: On-demand operator view; not posted anywhere

title: Export issues schedule 5pm UTC weekdays
description: The Export Issues workflow shall run on cron `0 17 * * 1-5` (one hour before Daily Report) and on manual dispatch.
acceptance_criteria: Runs `scripts/export-issues.py --post` | CSV uploaded as workflow artifact retained 90 days | Cron timed before daily-report so the latest CSV is available
notes: Ordered before daily-report by design

title: Cumulative state stage ordering
description: The cumulative state collector shall pick `status:empty` before `status:analyzed` to guarantee empty repos aren't double-counted.
acceptance_criteria: CUMULATIVE_STAGES order: empty, analyzed, dryrun-success, dryrun-failed, migrated, migrate-failed, archived | First-match wins per issue | Defensive ordering supplements set_status_label's mutex guarantee
notes: Belt-and-suspenders against stale labels

title: Provider pivot includes Unknown bucket
description: The report shall count issues with no `provider:*` label under an `Unknown` bucket so failed-without-provider issues don't disappear from the pivot.
acceptance_criteria: Per-source totals reconcile with sum of stage cells | Unknown displayed alphabetically last (pinned right) | Issues with no tracked stage skipped from pivot but counted in total
notes: Reconciliation invariant for downstream consumers

title: `/advise` CLI for on-demand failure analysis
description: The system shall expose `amp advise` as a CLI command that runs the 3-tier advisor against a specific issue.
acceptance_criteria: Same pipeline as the automatic post-failure run | `--format terminal` prints markdown to stdout; `--format md` posts comment | `--logs-dir` points at downloaded GHA logs for Tier 1/2 search
notes: Useful for retroactive triage of historical failures

title: Excel workbook export with three sheets
description: The system shall export an XLSX workbook containing Repos, Commands, and Summary sheets via `amp export`.
acceptance_criteria: Sheet 1 `Repos`: one row per open issue with parsed fields | Sheet 2 `Commands`: issue # + Apply Label column for round-trip | Sheet 3 `Summary`: counts and rollups
notes: Frozen header row, conditional formatting on risk columns

title: CSV export with grouped label prefixes
description: The system shall export issues to CSV with one column per label prefix group via `scripts/export-issues.py`.
acceptance_criteria: PREFIXES list defines column groups (provider:, size:, lfs:, status:, etc.) | INDIVIDUALS list adds boolean columns (submodules, ref:long, etc.) | --post flag uploads CSV to a pinned issue
notes: PREFIXES must be updated when adding new label groups

title: Post-migration prefixes in CSV columns
description: The CSV export shall include columns for `migration-fixes:`, `custom-properties:`, and `status:validate-` label prefixes.
acceptance_criteria: PREFIXES contains the post-migration prefix groups | Readiness-check prefixes (submodules:, actions:, codeowners:, duration:) also present | One column per prefix group | Status column filters main-lifecycle status:* labels only (status:validate-* lives in the Validate column)
notes: Exports follow labels (per CLAUDE.md)

title: Repos sheet readiness columns
description: The Excel Repos sheet shall include columns for Submodules Rewrite, Workflow Refs, CODEOWNERS, Secrets Present, Hardcoded URLs, Branch Protection, Migration Fixes, Custom Properties, and Validate.
acceptance_criteria: Headers list mirrors the analyze-time readiness label table | One column per `prefix:` group | Aligned with CSV PREFIXES so the two exports stay in sync
notes: Update both export paths together when labels evolve

title: Import commands round-trip from Excel
description: The system shall read the Commands sheet from an XLSX file and emit `gh issue edit ... --add-label` commands via `amp import-commands`.
acceptance_criteria: Reads column D `Apply Label` for non-empty values | Emits one shell command per issue/label pair | Commands printed to stdout for operator review
notes: Excel-driven bulk labeling round-trip

title: Analytics workbook with native pivots
description: The system shall export an analytics XLSX via `amp export-analytics` containing a filterable Data table, a State Changes sheet, and native Excel PivotTables (status x LFS/provider/size, primary blocker, LFS, age, source org x namespace).
acceptance_criteria: Data sheet formatted as Excel Table tblData reusing REPOS_HEADERS + Primary Blocker | Native PivotTables injected as OOXML parts (refresh on open) | Pivots stacked per tab to avoid Excel overlap | `--countifs-pivots` falls back to no native pivots
notes: openpyxl cannot author pivots; parts injected and verified by round-trip load

title: Per-state-change history export
description: The system shall emit one row per `status:`/`cmd:` label transition (added and removed) with actor, stage, timestamp, and elapsed-since-previous via `amp state-history` / `scripts/state-changes.py` / the analytics State Changes sheet.
acceptance_criteria: Rows sourced from GitHub GraphQL timelineItems (LABELED + UNLABELED) | Two-level pagination past 100 timeline events | Sorted by issue then timestamp with per-issue Seq and Elapsed (h) | status:* mapped to STAGES; cmd:* mapped to stage `command`
notes: Only history source is GitHub timeline; AMP stores none locally

title: In-table command builder with dropdowns
description: The analytics Data table shall provide Action (add/remove) and Command (cmd:*) dropdowns and a gh Command formula, and `amp import-commands` shall emit commands for only the filter-visible rows.
acceptance_criteria: Command dropdown sourced from get_label_names_by_category('commands') via hidden _lists sheet | gh Command formula builds `gh issue edit <#> -R <repo> --add-label/--remove-label` | import-commands skips autofilter-hidden rows | Reads analytics Data sheet or classic Commands sheet
notes: Filter-then-run keeps bulk ops scoped to the selected repos

title: Bulk-assign concurrent label apply
description: The system shall apply CSV-driven `dst-org:`, `dst-team:`, `dst-prefix:` labels to many issues concurrently via `amp bulk-assign`.
acceptance_criteria: Default worker count 8 via ThreadPoolExecutor | Idempotent: re-running same CSV is a no-op | Failed rows written to `<csv>.failures.csv` for re-run
notes: Designed for tens of thousands of issues

title: Bulk-assign removes mismatched prefix labels
